distractors.reason: We don't say 'family camera' to mean a picture of relatives. A camera is the device that takes the picture, not the picture itself.
We don't say 'family phone' to mean a photo of the family. 'Family phone' would mean a phone shared by the family.
We don't say 'family book' to mean a picture of relatives. A book is printed text or pages.

example_sentence: We have a nice family photo on the wall.
l1_interference: В українській мові прикметник зазвичай стоїть перед іменником, а в англійській 'family' виконує роль прикметника і теж стоїть перед іменником 'photo'. Українці можуть помилково поставити слова в зворотному порядку і сказати 'photo family'.
explanation: In English, a noun can come before another noun to describe it, as in 'family photo'. The first noun works like an adjective and tells us what kind of photo it is.

related_collocations.example: We drew our family tree for school.
We bought a big family car last year.
We have a family dinner every Sunday.

memory_tip: The first noun describes the second: family photo = a photo of the family, phone book = a book of phone numbers
